name: Colossus

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.

signatureAbility:
The Mighty Colossus!
Whenever one of Colossus' Immunities protects him from an effect, he has a [23 - 52]% chance to gain an Armor Up Buff, lasting 15 seconds.
Colossus has a [16 - 45]% chance to convert an expiring Armor Up Buff into a permanent one.
immunityDetails:
• Kanama Bağışıklığı 🩸
• Yakma Bağışıklığı 🔥
• Ani Soğuk Bağışıklığı 🧊
• Zırh Kırma Bağışıklığı (tech'ler hariç) 🛡️

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Colossus is Immune to all Bleed, Incinerate, Coldsnap & Frostbite effects. Additionally, if he's not fighting a Tech Champion, he's also immune to Armor Break and Armor Shattered Debuffs.
At the start of the fight, Colossus gains a number of indefinite Armor Up Buffs equal to 2 plus the number of X-Men Champions on his team, including himself.

abilitySections.title: Personal Armor Up Buffs - Max: 20
content: Unless otherwise stated, Colossus's Armor Up Buffs provide [305.56] Armor Rating.
Additionally for each Armor Up Buff Colossus has, he gains an additional [85.05] Critical Damage Rating.

abilitySections.title: When Attacked or When Attacking
content: If Colossus' Ability Accuracy is below 100%, he gains +100% Combat Power Rate for the duration of the attack.

abilitySections.title: Enemy Critical Hits
content: Damage is capped at 150% of the opponent's Attack rating.
Each time this damage cap is hit, the duration of Colossus' Armor Up Buffs are refreshed. Additionally he has a 50% chance to gain an additional Armor Up Buff lasting 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Well Timed Blocks
content: 100% chance to gain an Armor Up Buff, lasting 15 seconds.
If contact is made by basic attacks, Colossus has a 100% chance to inflict a Stun Debuff lasting 1 seconds.
If Colossus has the Parry Mastery, this Stun Debuff is disabled and instead a successful Parry also deals [5,035.5] direct damage.

abilitySections.title: Special and Heavy Attacks
content: Attack rating is increased by up to +[20,142], based on Colossus's Armor Rating.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: If the Opponent has a Stun Debuff, Colossus's Heavy Attacks have a 100% chance to Purify the Stun and grant a Passive Fury increasing Attack by up to +[35,248.5], based on Colossus's Armor, for 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Gain an indefinite Armor Up Buff.
Flat 5% chance per Armor Up Buff to inflict a Stun Debuff for 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: This attack is Unblockable.

When activated, for each Armor Up Buff, Colossus has a 50% chance to gain another lasting 15 seconds. These Buffs do not count towards the Max Stack limit, allowing Colossus to temporarily go above his Armor Up Buff limit.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict an indefinite Passive Fatigue on the opponent, reducing their Critical Rating by [2,750].

Colossus activates Organic Steel increasing the amount of Damage reduced by Armor and Resistances by 2% per Armor Up Buff. Additionally while Organic Steel is active, Colossus is Unstoppable while Blocking allowing him to shrug off attacks.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - The Mighty Colossus!
content: Whenever one of Colossus' Immunities protects him from an effect, he has a [23 - 52]% chance to gain an Armor Up Buff, lasting 15 seconds.
Colossus has a [16 - 45]% chance to convert an expiring Armor Up Buff into a permanent one.
